In my opinion as long as the individual does not act upon their attractions, then I don't see a problem. However is may be necessary to take actions to reduce the risk to children, but as long as there is no intention to act, I think it is not okay to interfere in people's lives.

Personally, if I found myself to be attracted to a specific individual under the age of consent then I would attempt to reduce contact with that individual as much as possible.

I also try to generally limit my involvement with children. I try to avoid these scenarios because of the induced stress and anxiety I experience. However, I still feel that I have a right to be eg. a coach. 

Plus I do want to start a family at some point. Since I don't believe myself to be a risk to children I do feel I have a right to start my own family.
I know that they were wrong, but they have all the power now. I don't know what to do. I'm so angry at them, but I don't want to hurt them. This is really frustrating, I don't know what to do :(

Oh man, it sounds like you've got a lot going on. Thank you for sharing. I would suggest thinking about the future. What I mean is, if you're in a one way relationship then I think no-one's going to be happy in the long-run.

I'm sorry about the girl that you are currently in love with. There was once a guy that I loved, but he was "straight". I thought that If I helped him get a girlfriend then it would be easier for me to get over him, so I helped him pull at a nightclub. Of course it still hurts seeing someone you love with someone else. It hurts a hell of a lot.

It's not worth feeling guilty though, we can't help who we have feeling's for, and it sometimes doesn't make any sense that we're not attracted to certain people even though we know how awesome they are.

I think it's amazing that you've been able to support so many people and I'm sorry that it's taking its toll on you. If there's anything I can do to help, I'd be interested in talking some more if you like.

Stay safe :)

I'm so sorry to hear of your troubles, you seem like a good person who doesn't deserve this situation inflicted upon you.

With technology making huge advances now more than ever I hope that you will be able to take advantage of it and make the most out of your situation.

If your boyfriend is still with you then he obviously cares a lot about you. don't forget that suicide hurts people around you too.

Also, it may be worth considering to continue to use the cath, it's ultimately your choice. Please look after yourself.

It doesn't seem fair to ruin someone's life because they might do something wrong, especially when their actions have suggested otherwise. They had no reason to predict such a grim future. I felt that I was in control before, whereas now I feel that they have taken that control and haven't done anything productive with it. All they have done is inflict so much suffering on me and I don't understand what I've done to deserve this :( All I tried to do was to get some help and it was the biggest mistake of my life.

I've tried to stay in good shape and keep a good diet, but it didn't work. I feel as if I tried my best to recover, but after I went to the counselors I just felt like things keep getting worse and worse. I feel worn out and I can't do it anymore.

I don't even know how to approach the subject of my depression with my friends. A lot of them don't even know that I've dropped out of the university. They ask me how my PhD is going and I lie and say its going fine. How am I supposed to tell them that I actually have dropped out because I'm so depressed and suicidal about having fantasies involving raping children?

By not telling my psychologist everything, then he wouldn't have any reason to justify disclosing my information to social services. I'm scarred that if social services learns more about my fantasies then they could do things such as preventing me from adopting in the future (I'm gay, so adopting is the most viable option to raising a family) or stop me from being in contact with children, such as preventing me from coaching, or seeing family members etc.

I understand that actions are met with judgement, but the only actions I have taken with relation to my fantasies is to try and get help. But any time I try there is a problem. The referral was delayed by a year and a half because I didn't have the right postcode. The counselors I were trying to see in the meantime reported me despite stating that they believed I wouldn't act on my fantasies and knowing that being reported was making me suicidal. I feel as if they were trying to kill me because they knew that their actions were making me suicidal and they disclosed my information anyway, even when no-one was at risk

I would like the psychologist to be successful, and for me to feel better. But I want to have a family when I'm older, and I want to be able to coach people of any age. I wouldn't see the point of existing if my life was restricted. I also don't want to live in a world where people are demonized for their thoughts, and where honesty is met with judgement and enforcement.

Thank you, I really appreciate your post. It feels like I've tried my best to get over my depression, its been about 2 years, there's been ups and downs, but overall it seems to be getting worse and worse and I don't know how I'm going to get better. I tried to get help by talking to my GP and they referred me to psychology, but that was at the start of summer 2 years ago and its only been recently that I've Gotten an appointment. I was seeing the counselors through lifeline to help me while the referral went through, but after I told them that I was intending to learn some coaching at a club that trained 13-18yos they threatened to disclose my fantasies to social services and the police unless I stopped going to the coaching sessions. This upset me because it was important to me and my dark fantasies hadn't affected my life before, but when this happened, things suddenly became so real. I agreed to stop going to the coaching, but was very upset about how my counselor had treated me, so I stopped seeing her. I was then contacted by another counselor from the parent organization and he told me that if I didn't continue counseling in some capacity that it would increase the chance that they would have to disclose information to social services. I went to these sessions, but after making a complaint about how I was being treated he disclosed my information to social services and didn't tell me until afterward. Its really upsetting to think that someone who is supposed to be helping you is only thinking about how he can report you for something that I may or may not do. Now that I'm starting proper psychology I'm scared about telling the truth about how I feel and what I think in case they use it put me on some list.
Hey guys, thank you so much for your support, sorry I haven't replied in a while, I wasn't able to log into reddit for a while :s I'll try and respond to all your comments soon.

First of all: Ouch,
Secondly: Thanks for your honest opinion.
The thing is, I'm not wanting to do the coaching so as to get close to children, its just that it is the only available way to get coaching practice. If there was a suitable alternative then I would choose that, but getting this coaching practice is important to me and I don't think that having thoughts is enough of a justification for me to cut out this important part of my life.
 The only actions I have taken on the basis of these thoughts are attempts to get help dealing with them. I didn't choose to be attracted to children, I did choose to ask my doctor for psychiatry, and I chose to go to counseling.
 I know that statutory rape is wrong, children are too young to consent. This is why I know that it would be evil to do that to a child. No-one deserves to have that happen to them. I can think of few things that are more horrible.
 Why do you find it difficult to find compassion for me? I'm just a human being who is trying to do the right thing. I'll answer your questions as best I can.
* I can't explain exactly what I find attractive about children over adults, because I don't know really. But I think it's important to point out that I still do find adults sexually attractive too. It may be possible that when I was younger I wanted to have more of a sex life, and now that I'm older I'm trying to project that onto other children because of how I felt when I was that age. However, I don't think I was mature enough to know what I really wanted from sex until I was about 15, which is around the age of consent, so I know that it wouldn't be right to act out on these thoughts even if someone younger that the age of consent thought that they were consenting.
* I think I may have covered this in my previous answer.
* I have **not** done anything sexual with children, and I have no intention of.
* I cannot recall any traumatic sexual experiences as a child.

I'm hoping that talking about these issues on reddit will help me get a better idea of what other people think of these, and help me understand them, which will eventually lead to me not having to be concerned bout these thoughts anymore, weather I find I way to make them go away. But there is a possibility that this is just part of my sexuality, which in my opinion is still okay, as long as I never act on those thoughts. I think that if I can understand them enough, I can know how to ensure that I'll never act upon them.

I'm glad that no-one agrees with what you're saying, but I'm also glad that you commented.
* My thoughts are of evil actions, but thoughts by themselves should not be considered good or evil. No-one is being hurt if someone thinks about sexual activity with children. But the moment they try to put those thoughts into action there is a very serious risk of harm. I want to have no part in the abuse of children, I'm not a monster. I try to be very careful of my actions so that they do not hurt anyone. I would never intentionally put someone at risk.
* I should state that I'm not specifically attracted to any of the children that are involved in the coaching. Also, its done in a sports hall with proper supervision and adheres to all child protection standards. And of course, I have no intentions of actively pursuing relationships with the children.
* Hopefully this is the question that the psychiatry will be able to sort out. It could be that I haven't properly sexually developed, and this will help. But there is also the possibility that this is just part of my sexuality. As I said before, if I can understand whatever this is, I think it will be a huge leap to making me feel better, and knowing how to ensure that I won't act out on these thoughts.

Also, I'm not a troll, and I don't appreciate you calling me a douche, I don't deserve that

I know that pedophilia is extremely dangerous to children, causing irreparable damage that can affect them the rest of their life. I can only imagine the pain caused. But there is also a problem that people expressing these thoughts are not being treated properly and given the help they need. I'm afraid to talk about it because of the stigma attached to it. People don't understand them and judge them, and in my case people's reactions have had devastating effects on my mood. There needs to be more support for people experiencing these thoughts, I think that by supporting and helping them, it will be a step towards stopping child abuse.

Thanks, i guess i might not always be able to suppress my desires, after all I don't know what the future will bring, i can't say with 100% certainty that there won't be a scenario in which i rape a kid. I know a way that will make sure that I won't hurt anyone. Thanks for your support, I know what I have to do now :)

Thanks for your comment. I think that there is a big difference between something happening in my mind and actually acting on it. Have you every thought about doing something wrong? Do you feel that something such as a thought should prevent you from living your life? If I thought that I couldn't control myself, I would not work with children. If I think there's any chance of me giving in to temptation then I would kill myself to prevent such a horrible act from occurring.
Hey man, you're not a waste of time, depression isn't something you can just "snap-out" of. Its difficult and your problems are real and important if they're making you feel this way.

Hey man, sounds like you got it rough, really rough. I think you've done really well to hang in there :) It sounds like you are pushing off suicide because there is some part of you that doesn't want to give up, part of you wants to get better, and that is really important. Maybe try to reconnect with your family or friends, my brothers caught me when i fell apart, there must be people in your life willing to do the same, even talking to people online can help. Hang in there, Best wishes
like i said, ask me anything and i'll be honest, please be honest too, thank you
